p = np.array([1/6]*6)        # a toy pmf
assert (p >= 0).all()          # axiom 1
assert np.isclose(p.sum(), 1)  # axiom 2
# disjoint events: P(A u B) = P(A) + P(B)
assert np.isclose(p[:2].sum(), p[0] + p[1])
caption: Any function satisfying all three is a valid probability measure.
